filament_notes: SUNLU High Speed Matte PETG 1.75 mm, 1 kg. SimplyPrint/Open Filament Database: nozzle 240-260 C, bed 70-80 C, density 1.28. printer-hub.ru: 240-250 C for 100-300 mm/s, 260-270 C above 300 mm/s, dry 65 C 6 h, not abrasive. Cap 22 mm3/s at 255 C: Prusa Elegoo Rapid PETG is 25 and Sunlu PETG 20 on CORE One HF0.4 (INDX runs about 0.82 of that). PA 0.048 from the Sunlu PETG tune. Raise the cap with a max-flow test. T8 version for the 1.0 mm high-flow nozzle: Prusa has no 1.0 PETG, so temperature, cap and fan follow Prusa Prusament PETG @COREONE HF0.8 (260 C, 37 mm3/s, fan 30-65, bridges 65, layer time 20/35 s) scaled to this filament and to INDX; pressure advance is the 0.4 value x0.447 (Prusa 0.4 to 0.8 ratio) x0.69 (0.8 to 1.0 step used for the CF profiles). Raise the cap with a max-flow test.
